Super Groundcar. Upgrades: Armored Chassis, Autopilot Terminal, Bulletproof Glass [x2], Bulwark Armor, Combat Plow, Communications Center, CrystalCoat, CrystalDome, Heavy Chassis, Improved Engine, Reinforced Tires, Sealed Environment, TUp (Hardwired Locks) Security Upgrade (Advanced). No Housing Capacity or Seating Upgrade. Arriving in it: +8 Wardrobe & Style to get into luxury places. Its locker holds a High Fashion wardrobe (up to 40,000eb, no jewelry) and a jewelry box (up to 500,000eb), all GPS-tagged to the car: take them too far for too long and Rayfield comes asking.
